text: My office has received complaints from the Robert Hicks community regarding the wait times to make a northbound left turn onto Torresdale Avenue when travelling eastbound on Finch Avenue. Torresdale Avenue is the only vehicular entrance and exit point into and out of the neighbourhood which is surrounded by G. Ross Lord Park to the west, Hydro fields to the north, the Herbert H. Carnegie Centennial Centre to the east and Finch Avenue to the south. Because Torresdale Avenue is the only entrance point, the left turn lane on Finch Avenue onto Torresdale Avenue clogs up during peak times daily and worsens congestion on Finch Avenue West. This neighbourhood contains hundreds of households, including a high-rise, whose residents need to use this entrance to reach their homes. Installing an advance left turn feature northbound onto Torresdale Avenue from Finch Avenue would positively impact…

North York Community Council: 1. Directed the Director, Transportation Services, North York District, to study the implementation of a northbound left-turn advance feature at the intersection of Finch Avenue West and Torresdale Avenue and report back to North York Community Council at its July 4th, 2018 meeting.
